values.name: ISSUEZ_OP_SET
values.doc: scalar or option: the value

values.doc: scalar: none; set: empty; option: default

values.name: ISSUEZ_OP_ADD
values.doc: set or list option: one member

values.name: ISSUEZ_OP_REMOVE
values.doc: set: one member

values.name: ISSUEZ_OP_INHERIT
values.doc: milestone: follow the parent's

values.name: ISSUEZ_OPT_EXPECT
values.doc: writes: oid. Fail with VERSION_MISMATCH if the tip isn't this

values.name: ISSUEZ_OPT_SUBJECT
values.doc: writes: str. Commit subject where the library picks one

values.name: ISSUEZ_OPT_ORIGINAL_AUTHOR
values.doc: writes: str. Provenance for imports; not an issue field

values.name: ISSUEZ_OPT_ORIGINAL_ID
values.doc: writes: str

values.name: ISSUEZ_OPT_EDIT_COMMENT
values.doc: update: oid. The write edits this comment instead: COMMENT SET is its new text, with ATTACHMENTS, EXPECT and SUBJECT

values.name: ISSUEZ_OPT_EXPECT_EDITS
values.doc: update: num. Fail with VERSION_MISMATCH unless the text the write edits (the description with SET DESCRIPTION, the comment with EDIT_COMMENT) was edited exactly this often (its EDIT revisions): a form's version of the text, which other changes to the issue don't touch

values.name: ISSUEZ_OPT_DELETE_COMMENT
values.doc: update: oid. The write hides this comment instead; only EXPECT and SUBJECT go with it

values.name: ISSUEZ_OPT_RESTORE_COMMENT
values.doc: update: oid. The write shows this hidden comment again; only EXPECT and SUBJECT go with it

values.doc: update: oid. The comment REACTIONS ADD or REMOVE is on; without it, the issue

values.name: ISSUEZ_OPT_Q_DELETED

values.name: ISSUEZ_OPT_Q_STATE

values.name: ISSUEZ_OPT_Q_NO_LABELS

functions.name: issuez_version
functions.doc: "1.2.3", or "1.2.3-12-ga3e21cfa" built from a git checkout past the tag. Static storage.

functions.name: issuez_init
functions.doc: Checks that the header and the library match: ISSUEZ_E_ABI when they don't. Optional: the first call of any function initialises the library; further calls are cheap no-ops.

functions.name: issuez_oid_hex
functions.doc: Writes the lowercase hex and a NUL into buf (ISSUEZ_OID_HEX_BUFSIZE bytes). Returns the hex length (40 or 64), 0 for a none oid.

functions.name: issuez_oid_parse
functions.doc: Full hex only.

functions.name: issuez_code_name
functions.doc: Static and stable, e.g. "VERSION_MISMATCH".

functions.name: issuez_error_message
functions.doc: One sentence for humans, English, no trailing newline.

functions.name: issuez_error_subject
functions.doc: What it is about, when known: an issue UUID, a ref, a field key.

functions.name: issuez_error_git_stderr
functions.doc: git's stderr (trimmed, bounded), for GIT, NETWORK and LFS.

functions.name: issuez_error_current_tip
functions.doc: VERSION_MISMATCH: the issue's tip now.

functions.name: issuez_error_problems
functions.doc: INVALID_VALUE and GUARD carry every problem found. May be NULL.

functions.name: issuez_error_write
functions.doc: A write that failed after its commit landed: its receipt, borrowed from err. NULL in this version: a cancelled write didn't happen, and one whose commit landed returns OK.

functions.name: issuez_field_key
functions.doc: Trailer key ("Labels", "X-Due-Date"), static storage.

functions.name: issuez_problems_free
functions.doc: Only for lists returned as owned (`issuez_problems **out`).

functions.name: issuez_ops_validate
functions.doc: Format rules only (no repo): verbs, slots, value grammar, default limits. *out is an empty list when everything is fine.

functions.name: issuez_cancel_new
functions.doc: NULL when out of memory.

functions.name: issuez_cancel_trigger
functions.doc: Thread-safe and idempotent; affects every call using this token.

functions.name: issuez_set_logger
functions.doc: Process-wide. Called from any thread, possibly concurrently; the event lives only during the call. Must not call back into issuez. NULL cb disables.

functions.name: issuez_repo_open
functions.doc: path: a work tree, any directory in it, or the git dir of a bare repo. opts: ISSUEZ_OPT_GIT_PATH .. ISSUEZ_OPT_CACHE_ISSUES (may be NULL, 0). Checks git's version; git sessions start lazily.

functions.name: issuez_repo_close
functions.doc: Drops the caller's reference (see Ownership).

functions.name: issuez_repo_set_logger
functions.doc: A logger for this repo's calls, in place of the process-wide one (issuez_set_logger) while they run; the same rules. NULL cb goes back to the process-wide one.

functions.name: issuez_repo_drop_all
functions.doc: Deletes every ref of the library's (issues, milestones, attachments, tombstones and local state) in one transaction; *dropped is how many. It undoes an import into a repository that had none, with no writes running. Not a purge: clones keep their copies and sync them back.

functions.name: issuez_repo_begin_import
functions.doc: A staging repo inheriting repo's settings and options, sharing its objects. Replay with ordinary writes, then commit_import. Closing it removes its private refs, also after failure. The target stays alive while staging. Do not write to a staging repo concurrently with commit or close.

functions.name: issuez_repo_commit_import
functions.doc: Publishes staging's shared refs to its target in one transaction. CONTENDED if a target ref already exists; no refs are published then. Call once on success, stop writing and close staging. Does not publish local cache refs.

functions.name: issuez_repo_adopt_refs
functions.doc: Creates in repo every issue, milestone, attachment and tombstone ref from has, in one transaction; *adopted is how many. An import written into a scratch repository whose git uses repo's objects (GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY) lands at once or not at all. CONTENDED when repo has one of them, CORRUPT when a tip's object isn't in repo's store; nothing is taken then.

functions.name: issuez_settings_write
functions.doc: Writes git config issue.doneStates and issue.workflowStates, what a settings page saves. ops: DONE_STATE and WORKFLOW_STATE, ADD each state (the key is set to them) or CLEAR (the key is unset: the defaults). Every state is checked first (INVALID_VALUE). Handles opened afterwards see the new settings.

functions.name: issuez_repo_limit
functions.doc: The effective value of a limit ("max_attachment_bytes", "cas_retries", the names ISSUEZ_OPT_LIMIT takes); false for no such limit.

functions.name: issuez_repo_workflow_state_count
functions.doc: The effective settings, from opts or git config.

functions.name: issuez_resolve
functions.doc: User input to UUIDs: a full UUID, a unique prefix ("a7f3"), a number ("#12"), or for milestones a name. OK with 0, 1 or more matches.

functions.name: issuez_search
functions.doc: Every hit in every issue that isn't deleted, by issue UUID. flags: issuez_search_flag bits.

functions.name: issuez_label_counts_take
functions.doc: Every label in use, by name.

functions.name: issuez_people_take
functions.doc: Everyone who opened or is assigned an issue, by email (compared ignoring case).

functions.name: issuez_short_ids_take
functions.doc: For every issue, the shortest prefix of its UUID that no other issue's starts with, at least min long: what a list shows so that issuez_resolve takes it.

functions.name: issuez_short_ids_at
functions.doc: In UUID order.

functions.name: issuez_short_ids_find
functions.doc: The prefix of a full UUID; {NULL,0} for one it doesn't know.

functions.name: issuez_resolve_one
functions.doc: Exactly one, or NOT_FOUND / AMBIGUOUS. Writes the UUID and a NUL into buf (ISSUEZ_UUID_BUFSIZE bytes).

functions.name: issuez_snapshot_at
functions.doc: The i-th entry, sorted by kind, then UUID.

functions.name: issuez_snapshot_encode
functions.doc: A stable, versioned binary encoding. The bytes live until s is freed.

functions.name: issuez_snapshot_decode
functions.doc: Empty bytes decode to an empty snapshot.

functions.name: issuez_diff_new
functions.doc: old_snap may be NULL (everything is created). Pure: no git.

functions.name: issuez_watch_start
functions.doc: Calls cb with issuez_watch_change bits once a burst of changes is quiet (and at least every 400 ms while it isn't), on a thread of its own; our own writes count too. cb must not call issuez_watch_stop. A changed path says something may have changed, not what: read again.

functions.name: issuez_watch_stop
functions.doc: No call to cb after it returns.

functions.name: issuez_issue_load_at
functions.doc: Loads the exact tip, even after its ref moved or disappeared. tip must be nonzero and use the repository's object format. since is optional, as in load_since. Historical objects must still exist; this does not retain purged objects.

functions.name: issuez_issue_load_since
functions.doc: issuez_issue_load, with each timeline entry's is_new saying whether its commit is new since the tip since: what a host that projected the issue at since hasn't seen, merged-in commits included. NULL since: every entry is new. A since outside the issue's history (a purge rewrote it, or it isn't this issue's) makes none new and issuez_issue_rewritten true.

functions.name: issuez_issue_rewritten
functions.doc: issuez_issue_load_since's since isn't in the history: the host can't tell what is new. False from other loads.

functions.name: issuez_issue_json
functions.doc: The issue as git issue show --json writes it (docs/json.md; ISSUEZ_JSON_FLAG_FULL adds the description, comments and history), UTF-8: one call for a binding that would rather parse JSON than call every accessor.

functions.name: issuez_issue_json_many
functions.doc: A JSON array of the issues with these full UUIDs, in their order; NULL ids and n 0: every issue that isn't deleted. Missing and damaged ones are left out.

functions.name: issuez_issue_load_many
functions.doc: In the order of ids. Missing and damaged ones are skipped (see issuez_issue_list_skipped_at) unless ISSUEZ_LOAD_FLAG_STRICT.

functions.name: issuez_issue_tip
functions.doc: Pass as expect.

functions.name: issuez_issue_state_name
functions.doc: "open", "closed", "wontfix", ...

functions.name: issuez_issue_is_done
functions.doc: closed or one of the repo's done states.

functions.name: issuez_issue_workflow_state
functions.doc: Defaulted for open issues; {NULL,0} for done ones.

functions.name: issuez_issue_closed
functions.doc: When and by whom the issue last became done; false while it isn't.

functions.name: issuez_issue_milestone_id
functions.doc: Direct only; the effective one (through parents) is a projection answer.

functions.name: issuez_issue_ref
functions.doc: A branch or tag.

functions.name: issuez_issue_original_author
functions.doc: An imported issue's author in the other tracker; {NULL,0} otherwise.

functions.name: issuez_issue_field
functions.doc: Any trailer by key, case-insensitive, as resolved (unknown ones too).

functions.name: issuez_issue_extra_count
functions.doc: Fields this library doesn't interpret (X-Forgejo-* and others).

functions.name: issuez_issue_problems
functions.doc: Invalid stored values (kept and ignored), unresolved events, and conflicts (two clones disagreed).

functions.name: issuez_issue_reaction_count
functions.doc: On the issue (comment NULL) or a comment.

functions.name: issuez_comment_reaction_count
functions.doc: The comment's reactions, from the record itself: the same as issuez_issue_reaction_count with its id.

functions.name: issuez_comment_attachment_at
functions.doc: The UUID of an attachment the comment's commit added; {NULL,0} past the end.

functions.name: issuez_query_run
functions.doc: ops: ISSUEZ_OPT_Q_*. Defaults: not done, not deleted, newest first, 100 per page. Q_TEXT is a fixed-string match, not a search engine.

functions.name: issuez_query_count
functions.doc: Ignores Q_LIMIT and Q_AFTER.

functions.name: issuez_issue_list_next_cursor
functions.doc: {NULL,0} on the last page.

functions.name: issuez_issue_list_skipped_count
functions.doc: Ids asked for or matched that couldn't be read (damaged).

functions.name: issuez_store_new
functions.doc: Empty until the first refresh.

functions.name: issuez_store_refresh
functions.doc: Reads the refs and loads what moved; *changed is false when nothing did and the handles stay valid.

functions.name: issuez_store_generation
functions.doc: Bumped by every refresh that changed something.

functions.name: issuez_store_issue_at
functions.doc: In UUID order; deleted ones too.

functions.name: issuez_store_find
functions.doc: By full UUID; NULL for none.

functions.name: issuez_store_changed_at
functions.doc: UUIDs of the issues the last refresh found created, changed or deleted.

functions.name: issuez_issue_check
functions.doc: Dry run: every problem the write would hit, without writing. OK with an empty list: it would succeed now. id {NULL,0}: as a create.

functions.name: issuez_issue_create
functions.doc: TITLE is required.

functions.name: issuez_issue_update
functions.doc: Every write to an existing issue: fields, a comment, a comment's edit, delete or restore (issuez_edit_comment, issuez_delete_comment, issuez_restore_comment), a reaction (issuez_add_reaction, issuez_reaction_target). A list that changes nothing (empty, or every value as it is) is OK and writes nothing (issuez_write_wrote).

functions.name: issuez_attachment_read
functions.doc: An attachment's bytes from the repository's store, checked against its trailer: what a front end shows. NOT_FOUND for no such issue or attachment, LFS when the bytes aren't in this clone (git lfs fetch), CORRUPT when they don't match.

functions.name: issuez_bytes_data
functions.doc: The bytes; not NUL-terminated text, binary.

functions.name: issuez_attachment_validate
functions.doc: Whether a write would take these bytes as an attachment (a PNG, JPEG or WebP, not animated, within the repo's limits), without writing. media_type (may be NULL) gets the type, a static string.

functions.name: issuez_attachment_prepare
functions.doc: Validates and hashes bytes once, sanitizes the name and chooses an ID when empty. Store the bytes in the host's LFS store before using the prepared op. The write requires ATTACHMENT_STORE 0 and checks metadata and limits again.

functions.name: issuez_prepared_attachment_info
functions.doc: Borrowed metadata for the host's storage, valid until p is freed.

functions.name: issuez_prepared_attachment_op
functions.doc: An ADD op borrowing p's metadata. Keep p until the write returns.

functions.name: issuez_write_wrote
functions.doc: false: nothing to write (a no-op list, an idempotent reaction).

functions.name: issuez_write_old_tip
functions.doc: len 0 on create.

functions.name: issuez_write_new_tip
functions.doc: The next expect.

functions.name: issuez_write_retries
functions.doc: Times the write started over after a concurrent change; usually 0.

functions.name: issuez_write_entry
functions.doc: The commit as a timeline entry, with its typed changes.

functions.name: issuez_write_load_issue
functions.doc: The issue as of the new tip, owned by the caller.

functions.name: issuez_write_load_milestone
functions.doc: The milestone at the receipt's exact new tip, owned by the caller.

functions.name: issuez_milestone_load_at
functions.doc: The milestone at an exact, nonzero tip, even after its ref moved or disappeared.

functions.name: issuez_milestone_updated
functions.doc: Of its latest commit.

functions.name: issuez_milestone_status_changed
functions.doc: When the status it has was set, by the last commit after the root that set it: a completed milestone's closing time. False when none did.

functions.name: issuez_milestone_author
functions.doc: Who created it.

functions.name: issuez_milestone_check
functions.doc: Fields: NAME (required on create), DESCRIPTION, DUE_DATE, MILESTONE_STATUS (COMPLETED is a GUARD problem while issues are open), plus ISSUEZ_OPT_EXPECT. id {NULL,0}: as a create.

functions.name: issuez_projection_around
functions.doc: What one issue's answers need: the issue, its ancestors, descendants and blockers. Its answers are those of issuez_projection_build, but for whom it blocks: that needs every issue.

functions.name: issuez_projection_issues
functions.doc: The issues it covers, borrowed.

functions.name: issuez_projection_root_count
functions.doc: Roots in tree order (a broken parent makes an issue a root).

functions.name: issuez_projection_active_blocker_count
functions.doc: Blockers that aren't done.

functions.name: issuez_projection_blocking_count
functions.doc: Issues this one blocks.

functions.name: issuez_projection_progress
functions.doc: Done and total leaves below the issue; false without sub-issues.

functions.name: issuez_projection_milestone_of
functions.doc: Direct or through parents; {NULL,0} for none.

functions.name: issuez_projection_problems
functions.doc: Problems across issues (missing parent, cycle, ...); id {NULL,0} for all.

functions.name: issuez_sync
functions.doc: opts: ISSUEZ_OPT_SYNC_*. OK even when some items failed or were quarantined: check the report.

functions.name: issuez_fsck
functions.doc: flags: issuez_fsck_flag bits. Without ISSUEZ_FSCK_FLAG_REPAIR nothing is written.

functions.name: issuez_fsck_report_at
functions.doc: In the order the checks ran.

functions.name: issuez_remote_default
functions.doc: The remote to set up when none is named: one entry (the only remote, else origin), none, or every remote when there are several and none is origin.

functions.name: issuez_remote_configure
functions.doc: Adds the refspecs remote lacks; idempotent. flags: issuez_remote_flag bits. NOT_FOUND for no such remote.

functions.name: issuez_sync_status_pending_at
functions.doc: The UUID of an issue not pushed yet; quarantined ones aren't counted.

functions.name: issuez_quarantine_resolve
functions.doc: Keep ours, or take theirs (the replaced version is kept). INVALID_ARGUMENT for ISSUEZ_CHOICE_UNKNOWN.

functions.name: issuez_push_check
functions.doc: opts: ISSUEZ_OPT_PUSHER .. ISSUEZ_OPT_ALLOW_PURGE. Reads the objects from the quarantine and writes nothing (format.md §11). OK when every verdict accepts, REJECTED otherwise (the verdicts are still set).

functions.name: issuez_push_verdict_entry_at
functions.doc: The new commits of an issue as timeline entries, k < entry_count.

functions.name: issuez_push_verdict_attachment_at
functions.doc: An attachment the new commits add, k < attachment_count: its sha256 and size are the LFS object the host's store must have before it accepts the push.

functions.name: issuez_purge_comment
functions.doc: Removes one comment's text and attachments; every later commit is rewritten, so tips change.

functions.name: issuez_purge_result_new_tip
functions.doc: len 0: the issue is gone.

functions.name: issuez_purge_result_exposed_remote_count
functions.doc: Remotes whose tracking refs show they had the purged commits, one synced by URL or path as the url-<hash> its refs are kept under. The next issuez_sync with each replaces their copy (leased on what it fetched).

functions.name: issuez_purge_result_attachment_count
functions.doc: The attachments the purge took out of history: a host drops its copies of their bytes.

functions.name: issuez_purge_result_attachment_at
functions.doc: A UUID.
